answer: An economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to stake scarce tokens and build a time-weighted reputation before receiving valuable jobs. Randomly selected, stake-weighted peers audit outputs; a quorum that detects collusion slashes dishonest identities’ bonds and lowers their trust. A fake swarm therefore costs capital and months of history, while coordinated deception risks losing the stake. In a willow garden, a lantern can signal each audit round.
